journal_lines: §oSmelled them an hour before they came over the ridge. Thousands of them, moving as one thing.
§aHerd crossing the open plain. §lStraggler§a at the rear, falling further behind. Took it clean.
Dust on the horizon all morning before the shapes resolved. Waited in the grass. Patience paid.
§aThe migration covered the valley floor. §oThe sound was low and constant and everywhere. Took what was needed.
Ran alongside the edge of the herd for a long time before picking the moment. The moment was worth waiting for.
§aGood haul from the rear animals. §lHerd§a that size will not notice the loss. Back next season.
The grass moved before the herd did. Then the herd. Then the grass again, on the other side of it.
Followed from downwind the whole approach. They knew anyway. The slow ones always know.
